title: Letter From HBM Consulate-General Re Malayan Communists

page_data.en:
MAL.C.P.
S. B. REGISTRY
No. D. 6954
Date 19-10-35

October 19 35.

My dear Barton,

Further to my letter dated August 31,1935,
I forward herewith for your information a copy of a
report regarding the Malayan Communist named Un Hong Siu
(尹鴻兆) alias Lau Ma(老馬) alias Ma Tsu(馬仔).

Yours sincerely,

（签名）

James Barton, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General.

（左侧批注：x Enclosed 19/10 A.C.B.）

1935年10月19日。

亲爱的巴顿：

继我1935年8月31日的信函之后，现随函附上关于马来亚共产党人尹鴻兆（Un Hong Siu），别名老馬（Lau Ma），别名馬仔（Ma Tsu）的报告副本，供你参考。

此致

敬礼

（签名）

詹姆斯·巴顿 先生，

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. REG. ST
No. S. B. D.
Special Branch
REPORT
Date October 18, 1935

Subject Letter from H.B.M. Consulate-General re Malayan Communists.

Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by D.S.J. Boyne

With reference to the enquiry from H.B.M. Consulate-
General on the above matter and in continuation of my
report dated August 30, 1935, I have to state that there are
no fresh developments in the case.

The Nanking Political Agent, with whom D.I. Kuh Pao
Hwa of this Section communicated by telephone, stated that
enquiries made by his agents indicate that UN HONG SIU (尹鴻兆)
alias LAU MA (老馬) alias MA TSU (馬伕) has not been
seen in Shanghai since he quitted the University.

It is interesting to record that TIAU PEK HUN (趙伯歡)
and TEN SIU LIAN (鄭萃連), the two Malayan students of the
Chinan University whom Un Hong Siu interested in the study
of communist doctrines are now teachers at this same
University.

There is nothing to show that either these two or
other inmates of the Chinan University have engaged in
subversive activities of any kind during the past several
months.

D.C. Special Branch D.S.
C.H. Jones

Mr Yao,
Please send copy with covering
note to British Consulate. J.A.G.
19 OCT. 1935

特别处
报告
日期 1935年10月18日

主题：英王陛下总领事馆关于马来亚共产党人的来信。

撰写人：警佐琼斯（D.S. Jones） 转呈人：警佐博伊恩（D.S.J. Boyne）

就英王陛下总领事馆关于上述事项的查询，并延续我1935年8月30日的报告，兹陈述本案无新进展。

南京政治专员与本处警探顾保华（Kuh Pao Hwa）通过电话沟通后表示，其特工进行的调查显示，尹鴻兆（UN HONG SIU），别名老馬（LAU MA），别名馬伕（MA TSU），自离开大学以来，未在上海露面。

值得注意的是，赵伯欢（TIAU PEK HUN）和郑萃连（TEN SIU LIAN），这两名暨南大学的马来亚学生曾受尹鴻兆影响研习共产主义学说，目前均在该校任教。

没有任何迹象表明，这两人或暨南大学的其他人员在过去几个月中从事过任何形式的颠覆活动。

特别处副主管
C.H. 琼斯 警佐

姚先生，
请附函将副本寄往英国领事馆。 J.A.G.
1935年10月19日

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. REG.S.
Special Branch S.2.
REPORT
Date. August 30, 1935
Subject. Attached letter from H.B.M. Consulate-General concerning Malayan
Communists.
Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by. D.S.J Coyne.

With reference the letter dated August 28, 1935 from
H.B.M. Consulate-General regarding one UN HONG SIU (尹鴻兆)
alias LAU MA (老馬 ) alias MA TSU (馬仔 ), a communist from
Malaya, a copy of the report accompanying the letter dealing
with this man has been taken and is attached herewith. The
original may therefore be returned to the Consulate.
The Chinese authorities, who have been communicated with
for information concerning present activities of Malayan
students at the Chinan University, state that these students
have not come to notice in recent months in connection with
subversive or other political activities.
Should UN HONG SIU visit Shanghai he would probably
travel by Chinese vessel and would undoubtedly conceal his
identity by using some name other than those by which he is
already known. This will make the task of tracing him doubly
difficult. However, it seems extremely likely that in the event
of his proceeding from Hongkong to Shanghai he would call on
former acquaintances at the Chinan University. By keeping
watch on known radical Malayan students at the University it
should be possible to learn whether UN HONG SIU visits there
or not. To do this effectively the cooperation of the Chinese
authorities will be essential. I therefore respectfully suggest
that D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa be permitted to inform the Shanghai
Public Safety Bureau that UN HONG SIU may visit Shanghai in
the near future and to request that the Bureau assist in
tracing this individual on the lines indicated.
There is nothing in Police records relating to TIAU PEK
HUN (趙伯), TEN SIU LIAN(鄭萃連), or HO GOAT SIAN (何月蟬),
whom UN HONG SIU is reported to have assisted when he was

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 REG.S.
特别处 S.2.
报告
日期：1935年8月30日
主题：英王陛下总领事馆关于马来亚共产党人的附信。
撰写人：警佐琼斯（D.S. Jones） 转呈人：警佐科因（D.S.J Coyne）。

参照英王陛下总领事馆1935年8月28日关于一名来自马来亚的共产党人尹鴻兆（UN HONG SIU），别名老馬（LAU MA），别名馬仔（MA TSU）的来信，已摘录随信所附关于此人的报告副本，并附于此处。因此，原件可退还领事馆。
经联系以获取关于暨南大学马来亚学生近期活动的信息的中国当局表示，这些学生在近几个月内未因颠覆或其他政治活动而引起注意。
如果尹鴻兆访问上海，他可能会乘坐中国船只，并且无疑会使用除已知别名之外的其他名字来隐藏身份。这将使追踪他的任务加倍困难。然而，如果他确实从香港前往上海，极有可能去拜访暨南大学的旧识。通过监视该校已知的激进马来亚学生，应该能够了解尹鴻兆是否到访。为了有效地做到这一点，中国当局的合作至关重要。因此，我建议允许警探顾保华（Kuh Pao Hwa）通知上海市公安局，尹鴻兆可能在不久的将来访问上海，并请求该局按照上述线索协助追踪此人。
警方记录中没有任何关于赵伯（TIAU PEK HUN）、郑萃连（TEN SIU LIAN）或何月蟬（HO GOAT SIAN）的内容，据报道，尹鴻兆在

page_data.en:
Un Hong Siu (尹鴻兆), @ Lau Ma (老馬; @ Ma Tsu
(馬仔), Cantonese aged 25 (1935), a Communist
in Kuala Lumpur, F.M.S.

Un Hong Siu is the second son of the late proprietor
Un Chong (尹松), the proprietor of a firm of gold and
silver merchants named :-

Chop Kong Hk (公益), 33, Cross Street,
Kuala Lumpur,
born in the F.M.S.

He received his early education at the Confucian
School, K.L. F.M.S., and was a member of the Young Men's
Progressive Society (in K.L.).

He then went to Shanghai and enrolled as a student
in the Chinan University where he assisted other
Malayan Students named:-

(1) Tiau Pek Hun (超伯歡),
(2) Ten Siu Lian (f)(鄭孝連),
and (3) Ho Goat Sian (f)(何月蟬),

to establish a branch of the above Society.

While in Shanghai he was an enthusiastic supporter
of the Students' Federation and participated in a move-
ment to overthrow Ten Hong Lian (鄭洪年), the then
Chancellor of the University which necessitated his
return to Malaya.

In 1932, Un Hong Siu interested himself in the
organization of several short-lived subversive societies
and as time went on his activities are reported to have
become further removed from the official C.P. of Malaya.
He still however holds Communistic views.

In 1934 he is reliably reported to have lent the
sum of $500 to Malayan "Central" (which has never been
repaid) and the same source has told us that Un Hong
Siu and not D. Ling was responsible for the translation
from English into Chinese of the "Letter to the Central
Committee of the M.C.P. from the P.E.B. of June, 1934"
(P.J. pages 22/25 and 32/35) but this is doubtful.
page_data.zh:
尹鴻兆（Un Hong Siu），@ 老馬（Lau Ma; @ 馬仔（Ma Tsu），广东人，25岁（1935年），马来联邦吉隆坡的共产党人。

尹鴻兆是已故店主尹松（Un Chong）的次子，其父是一家名为：

公益号（Chop Kong Hk），吉隆坡十字街33号，
的金银商行的店主，
出生于马来联邦。

他早期在马来联邦吉隆坡的孔教学校接受教育，曾是（吉隆坡）青年进步社的成员。

随后他前往上海，注册成为暨南大学的学生，在此期间，他协助其他名为以下的马来亚学生：

(1) 超伯歡（Tiau Pek Hun），
(2) 鄭孝連（Ten Siu Lian）(女)，
以及 (3) 何月蟬（Ho Goat Sian）(女)，

建立了上述社团的一个分支。

在上海期间，他是学生联合会的热烈支持者，并参与了一场推翻时任大学校长郑洪年（Ten Hong Lian）的运动，这导致他不得不返回马来亚。

1932年，尹鴻兆致力于组织几个短命的颠覆性社团，随着时间的推移，据报道他的活动进一步脱离了马来亚官方共产党。但他仍然持有共产主义观点。

据可靠消息，1934年他曾借给马来亚“中央”500美元（该款项从未偿还），同一消息来源还告诉我们，将“1934年6月马来亚共产党政治教育局致中央委员会的信”从英文翻译成中文的是尹鴻兆而非D. Ling（P.J. 第22/25页和第32/35页），但这一点存疑。

page_data.en:
-2-

Un Hong Siu has no official standing in the
Party's organisation but for some years has been in
the habit of procuring Communist literature from America
through the mail and translating suitable passages
therefrom into Chinese for the local party.

He has since July 1933, and is now, in
correspondence with Bun Teck Chai, the ex-Secretary of
the M.C.P. at present in jail in Hainan (P.J. page 91/34)
and various local activists have from time to time
received financial assistance from him when arrested
or banished. He is known to Amalu. M.C.P. Central
are at present trying to interest Un Hong Siu in the
reorganisation of the M.G.L.U. Railway Branch in the
F.M.S. Railway Workshops at Sentul, K.L. F.M.S. with
a view to organizing a further strike.
page_data.zh:
-2-

尹鴻兆在党的组织中没有正式地位，但多年来一直习惯于通过邮件从美国获取共产主义文献，并从中翻译合适的段落供当地党组织使用。

自1933年7月以来，他一直在与现任海南监狱囚犯、前马来亚共产党书记文德哉（Bun Teck Chai）（P.J. 第91/34页）通信，各种当地活动分子在被捕或被驱逐时，不时得到他的经济援助。Amalu认识他。马来亚共产党中央目前正试图让尹鴻兆参与重组马来联邦吉隆坡仙都铁路车间的马来亚总工会（M.G.L.U.）铁路支部，旨在组织进一步的罢工。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. D. REGISTRY
S. B. D. 6954
31. 8. 35

H.B.M. Consulate General,
Shanghai.
26th August, 1935.

My dear Givens,
I enclose herewith for your information a
note on a Malayan communist named UN HONG SIU who
is believed to have arrived in Hongkong on 7th August
and who may conceivably be intending to come to Shanghai.
I would be grateful if you would return the
note to me when you have extracted any information of
value to you from it. I should also be much obliged
if you would let me have any information available
concerning the present activities of students from
Malaya at the Chinan University.

Yours sincerely,
James Carlton.

$2
Information of
use obtained & abstracted
and paper returned direct
by me as requested
T. P. Givens, Esquire.
SHANGHAI.
J.K.S.
D.S. Jones. 30/8. 35
29 AUG. 1935

S. B. D. 6954
35. 8. 31

英王陛下总领事馆，
上海。
1935年8月26日。

亲爱的吉文斯：

现随函附上一份关于一名名为尹鴻兆（UN HONG SIU）的马来亚共产党人的笔记，供你参考。据信他已于8月7日抵达香港，并且可能打算前来上海。
如果你从中提取了任何对你有价值的信息，请将笔记归还给我，我将不胜感激。如果你能提供关于暨南大学马来亚学生目前活动的任何现有信息，我也将非常感激。

此致

敬礼
詹姆斯·卡尔顿。

$2
有用信息已获取并摘录，
文件已按请求直接由我退回
T. P. 吉文斯 先生。
上海。
J.K.S.
警佐琼斯。 1935年8月30日
1935年8月29日
